units.source_text: 他就步下长阶，走到庭中，拜舞答谢。

en.t: He descended the long steps, went into the courtyard, and performed a formal bowing dance in thanks.

units.source_text: 皇上又命赏赐左大臣左马寮[\[31\]](#part1330.html#m31)御马一匹、藏人所[\[32\]](#part1330.html#m32)鹰一头。

en.t: The Emperor also ordered that the Minister of the Left be given one imperial horse from the Bureau of Left Stables and one hawk from the Chamberlain's Office.

units.source_text: 其他公卿王侯，也都罗列阶前，各依身份拜领赏赐。

en.t: The other court nobles and princes also lined up before the steps and received gifts according to their ranks.

units.source_text: 这一天冠者呈献的肴馔点心，有的装匣，有的装筐，概出右大弁受命调制。

en.t: The dishes and sweets presented by the young man that day, some packed in boxes and some in baskets, had all been prepared under orders by the Major Controller of the Right.
In addition, there were the tondiki food gifts bestowed on everyone,

units.source_text: 以及犒赏诸官员的装在古式柜子里的礼品，陈列满前，

en.t: and the presents rewarding the various officials, packed in old-style cabinets and set out so fully before them,

units.source_text: 途几为塞，比皇太子加冠时更为丰富。

en.t: that the passageway was almost blocked; it was even more lavish than at the Crown Prince's coming-of-age ceremony.
The ceremony was truly magnificent beyond measure.
